sentenceSets.sentence: A tenacious advocate for the program, she continued making the case after every other proponent had moved to other priorities.

answerChoices.reasoning: Hesitant means reluctant or uncertain; the sentence shows someone who persistently continued advocacy after others abandoned it.
Flexible means willing to change; the sentence shows someone who stubbornly held to the program cause.
Fickle means prone to changing mind; the sentence shows someone who held fast to advocacy.
Passive means not actively involved; the sentence shows aggressive advocacy and persistent action.
Casual means not serious or committed; the sentence shows committed advocacy even after others moved on.
Superficial means shallow engagement; the sentence shows deeply committed, persistent engagement.
Apathetic means lacking concern; the sentence shows passionate, persistent advocacy.
Indifferent means unconcerned; the sentence shows someone who valued and actively advocated.
Yielding means giving way or surrendering; the sentence shows someone who held firm to advocacy.
Expedient means pursuing convenience or advantage; the sentence shows persistence based on principle.
Quitting means stopping effort but the sentence shows continued advocacy despite obstacles.

sentenceSets.sentence: The tenacious journalist's grip on the investigation did not waver despite threats and official pressure to drop the story.

answerChoices.reasoning: Loose means not tight or holding firmly; the sentence shows a firm grip unaffected by threats.
Wavering means uncertain or hesitant but the sentence explicitly shows grip 'did not waver.'
Reluctant means unwilling but the sentence shows determined pursuit despite pressure.
Timid means fearful; the sentence shows persistence despite threats.
Careless means not careful but the sentence shows focused, sustained investigation.
Half-hearted means lacking enthusiasm but the sentence shows determined persistence.
Apologetic means regretful but the sentence shows someone unaffected by external pressure.
Complacent means self-satisfied but the sentence shows active, sustained investigation.
Compliant means yielding to pressure but the sentence shows resistance to official pressure.
Submissive means yielding to others; the sentence shows firm resistance to pressure.
Obedient means following orders but the sentence shows defiance of pressure to abandon story.

sentenceSets.sentence: The tenacious adhesive held the broken ceramic through years of use, proving that the repair would outlast expectations.

answerChoices.reasoning: Slippery means not providing grip or friction; tenacious adhesive bonds firmly.
Weak means lacking strength but the sentence shows adhesive holding through years of use.
Temporary means lasting briefly but the sentence shows adhesive enduring for years.
Fleeting means passing quickly but the sentence shows adhesive maintaining bond durably.
Fragile means easily broken but the sentence shows durable, long-lasting adhesion.
Brittle means easily broken but the sentence shows adhesive surviving years of use.
Loose means not tight but the sentence shows firm adhesion through extended use.
Ineffective means not working but the sentence shows adhesive holding repair expectation.
Soluble means able to dissolve but the sentence shows adhesive maintaining bond.
Unstable means prone to change but the sentence shows stable adhesion.
Perishable means subject to decay but the sentence shows durability over years.
